bases.name: Highwind
bases.blurb: Heavily shortened story. Many dialogue choices and scenes are cut. Separate from CSR+.

bases.name: CSR+ (single-disc)
bases.blurb: CutScenes Removed + scene trims (Hojo, Aerith house, endgame), collapsed onto one Disc 1 image. Ask-menu removed, Supernova granted. Ending/credits movies ship separately; other non-ending movies are not preserved.
bases.betaNote: Single-disc is still playtesting; known freezes and glitches on some paths. Non-ending movies may show the wrong clip or glitch -- this is expected.

explainer.base: Base experience — only one applies (Unmodified, CSR, Highwind, …).
explainer.mods: Optional mods from other catalogs appear under Mods when available.
